build.buildCommand: bun install --no-save && bun --filter=@mercurjs/storefront run build && ( cd apps/storefront && [ -d .next/standalone/apps/storefront ] && { [ -d .next/standalone/apps/storefront/public ] || cp -a public .next/standalone/apps/storefront/public; } && { mkdir -p .next/standalone/apps/storefront/.next && [ -d .next/standalone/apps/storefront/.next/static ] || cp -a .next/static .next/standalone/apps/storefront/.next/static; }; true )

deploy.startCommand: cd apps/storefront/.next/standalone && PORT=${PORT} HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 node apps/storefront/server.js
